Placeholders like `${openmrsSpaBase}` are plain string substitution, done at the point of use rather than when config is loaded. `interpolateUrl()` fills in `openmrsBase` and `openmrsSpaBase` from the window globals and merges in any caller-supplied params. `interpolateString()` does the actual replacement, one key at a time.

**Implementation**

- `interpolateUrl(template, additionalParams)` reads `window.getOpenmrsSpaBase()` and trims its trailing slash. It passes `openmrsBase`, `openmrsSpaBase` and the extra params to `interpolateString`. It then collapses a leading `//` that the substitution can create, so `/${openmrsSpaBase}` doesn't become `//openmrs/spa`. (`openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-navigation/src/navigation/interpolate-string.ts:37-48`)
- `interpolateString(template, params)` replaces each literal `${key}` with its value using `split('${key}').join(value)`. (`openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-navigation/src/navigation/interpolate-string.ts:66-69`)
- `navigate()` runs `interpolateUrl` on `to` first, strips the origin, and then calls `navigateToUrl` if the target starts with the SPA base. Otherwise it uses `window.location.assign`. (`openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-navigation/src/navigation/navigate.ts:50-64`)
- `ConfigurableLink` sets its `href` via `interpolateUrl(to, templateParams)`. (`openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-react-utils/src/ConfigurableLink.tsx:66-74`)
- Config-driven URLs go through the same function. `createConfigLoader` in the app shell interpolates each `configUrls` entry before fetching it. (`openmrs-esm-core/packages/shell/esm-app-shell/src/run.ts:257-261`)
- Other components that call `interpolateUrl` on config values include the login logo and background, and the server-starting logo. (`openmrs-esm-core/packages/apps/esm-login-app/src/login-page-wrapper/login-page-wrapper.component.tsx:34`, `openmrs-esm-core/packages/apps/esm-login-app/src/logo.component.tsx:16`)
- Config validation restricts which placeholders are allowed. `isUrlWithTemplateParameters` accepts only `openmrsBase`, `openmrsSpaBase` and any names a schema adds. (`openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-config/src/validators/validators.ts:23-47`)

**Documentation**

- The `interpolateUrl` API docs give the examples and the expected output. (`openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-framework/docs/functions/interpolateUrl.md:9-31`)
- The `navigate` doc comment lists how `${openmrsSpaBase}` and `${openmrsBase}` resolve in each case. (`openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-navigation/src/navigation/navigate.ts:35-48`)
- The `interpolateString` docs cover the generic `${name}` substitution. (`openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-framework/docs/functions/interpolateString.md:3-17`)
- The O3 config docs say `configUrls` entries are interpolated at runtime with `interpolateUrl()`. (`openmrs-esm-contrib-o3-docs/content/en-US/docs/configure-o3/overview.mdx:369`) The branding page covers the same for logo and background images. (`openmrs-contrib-o3-docs/content/en-US/docs/configure-o3/configure-branding.mdx:212`)
- The tooling README says `configUrls` can use `${openmrsSpaBase}`, which the app fills in. (`openmrs-esm-core/packages/tooling/openmrs/README.md:213`)

**Not verified:** The real `window.getOpenmrsSpaBase` is not defined in the repositories I searched. I only found test stubs and a mock that builds it from `window.spaBase`. It is most likely set by the host page or the app shell at startup, but I did not confirm that. The search budget ran out before I could check.
